audit.whatIsWrong: Four rows read Teemo while their own why-text describes your window: whys[1] says to set the combo up (a wash, not a loss), whys[2] and whys[3] describe the level 3-5 dodge-stun trades, and whys[4] says your level-6 ultimate runs down an escapeless Teemo.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Teemo/Skill/Jax/Jax/Jax/Skill/Teemo at 50.9% over 890 games — his level 1, your 3 through 5, flattening at the first item and his again once shrooms wall the map.
audit.corrected: Rows set to Teemo / Skill / Jax / Jax / Jax / Skill / Teemo in both layers, ratings realigned to 2, 5, 7, 7, 7, 5, 2.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike was framed as raw duel stats and used the retired ultimate name.
audit.why: Data Dragon 16.15.1 names Jax's R Grandmaster-at-Arms; 'Grandmaster's Might' is the old name and the mirror audit counted 297 stale instances repo-wide. More importantly the ultimate's Armor and MR come from its activation on 110/100/90s, and all of Teemo's damage is magic — so it is a defensive answer to him specifically, not a generic steroid.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why, breakdown.late and mid now use Grandmaster-at-Arms and frame the resists as the on-demand answer to his magic damage.
sources: brief ownerKit R text and cd

audit.whatIsWrong: mid states 'Counter Strike only dodges basic attacks — it does nothing to his E-poison'. Toxic Shot is an on-hit applied by his basic attacks, so a dodged attack applies no poison either. The page understates your single best tool by telling the reader it does not work.
audit.why: Riot's Toxic Shot text: each of Teemo's attacks will poison the target on-hit. Counter Strike dodges all incoming attacks. Every point of Teemo's damage — autos, Element of Surprise burst, Toxic Shot — rides on a basic attack, so while Counter Strike is up his output is close to zero, not merely reduced (existing poison ticks still run). The mirror audit reached the same conclusion from Teemo's side and rewrote its page to 'fight the Counter Strike cooldown, never the ability'. Blinding Dart is a flat 7s at every rank and blinds your on-hit as well as your autos — that is the real timer.
audit.corrected: mid rewritten to state that a dodged auto carries no poison; breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t now carry the flat 7s Blinding Dart and the on-hit interaction.

audit.whatIsWrong: Blinding Dart was tracked without its number, and the number is unusually useful here because it does not scale.
audit.why: Blinding Dart is 7s flat at all five ranks, so the punish window never shrinks as the game goes on — unlike almost every other lane, the timing you learn at level 3 is the timing you use at level 18.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t and phases[3].why all carry the flat 7s.

edits.before: Counter Strike flips every AA exchange he starts. Only take the trade when Teemo's Blinding Dart is down.
edits.after: He blinds the instant you step up, so a level-2 Empower auto is wasted — set the combo up, do not force it.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Teemo must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full combo online: bait the blind, Leap Strike in, and Counter Strike blanks the poke autos before you stun him.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Blinding Dart's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Blinding Dart is a flat 7s at every rank — out-trade him in that gap, and ranking E keeps the dodge-stun up more often.

edits.before: Grandmaster’s Might stats win every extended duel from here on. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Teemo's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Grandmaster-at-Arms' Armor/MR active answers his magic damage, and the bonus on-hit plus a stun runs down a dash-less Teemo.

edits.before: Blinds your autos — your whole kit. Fight when down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Flat 7s at every rank, and it blinds your on-hit damage too — commit only once it is spent.

edits.before: - Teemo Blinding Dart: matchup-defining — Blinds your autos — your whole kit. Fight when down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Teemo Blinding Dart: flat 7s at every rank — it blinds your autos and your on-hit alike, so fight it spent. - Counter Strike blanks his autos AND the Toxic Shot they carry. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.

edits.before: Track Teemo's Blinding Dart: Blinds your autos — your whole kit. Fight when down. When it is down — Q-E-W him.
edits.after: Blinding Dart is flat 7s and kills your on-hit too. Counter Strike blanks his autos and their poison.

edits.before: Grandmaster’s Might stats win every extended duel from here on — build your teamfight around that. Teemo carry threat: 8.5/10 — shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: Grandmaster-at-Arms' active resists win the extended duel — build your teamfight around that. Teemo carry threat: 8.5/10 — shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.

edits.before: This is your window, but it's narrow. Counter Strike only dodges basic attacks — it does nothing to his E-poison or the moment his Q is thrown — so the whole lane is timing Blinding Dart's cooldown: when it's down, Leap Strike in, Empower the landing hit, and recast the stun before he kites out. At 6, Grandmaster at Arms is your spike — the Armor/MR active shrugs off his poison DPS and the bonus on-hit plus a stun is a clean kill if you caught him without Q. Force every all-in here; he has no dash and no escape once you stick to him.
edits.after: This is your window, and it is wider than it looks. Counter Strike dodges basic attacks — and Toxic Shot is an on-hit, so a dodged auto carries no poison either; while E is up his damage is close to nothing. The lane is still timed on Blinding Dart, a flat 7s: when it's down, Leap Strike in, Empower the landing hit, and recast the stun before he kites out. At 6 Grandmaster-at-Arms' Armor/MR active answers his magic damage, and the bonus on-hit plus a stun is a clean kill if you caught him without Q. He has no dash once you stick.

notes: Repo-wide naming issue confirmed by the mirror audit: Data Dragon 16.15.1 calls Jax's R 'Grandmaster-at-Arms', while 'Grandmaster's Might' appears ~297 times across champ-data. I corrected the instances inside the strings I was already rewriting on this page and left the rest for a sweep — the same stale name appears in my other jax proposals (ryze, sett, shen, singed, sion, swain, sylas, tahmkench) in fields I did not otherwise need to touch. suspectNames entries here are all false positives.
